test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the part of the sentence that contains a grammatical error.

Either the ethics protocol (1)/ or the procedural memo (2)/ were responsible for (3)/ the reporting delay. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The subject-verb agreement in the sentence is incorrect.
 
• The phrase "**Either...or**" requires the verb to agree with the subject closest to it.
 
• In this case, the subject closest to the verb is "**procedural memo**," which is singular.
 
• Therefore, the verb should be "**was**" instead of "**were**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Either the ethics protocol or the procedural memo was responsible for the reporting delay."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "Either the ethics protocol" **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "or the procedural memo"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **4: "the reporting delay."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
